concept: Full-body concept art of a giant monstrous slug for a video game. A long soft glistening body, sickly green with dark spots, covered in shiny slime, with a rounded front end carrying a small mouth with tiny teeth and two long thin eye stalks ending in yellow eyes. Rig-ready pose: the body is stretched out straight, the front third raised up off the ground like a slug looking around, the two eye stalks pointing up and clearly separated from each other. Seen from a three-quarter front view: its head is turned towards the lower left of the image, so that we see both its face and the whole length of its long body stretching back to the right. One single creature, centered, the whole body visible. Plain uniform light grey studio background, no floor, no ground, no pedestal, no cast shadow, soft even studio lighting.
desc_courte: giant monstrous slug, glistening sickly green body with dark spots and slime, raised front with small toothed mouth and two long eye stalks with yellow eyes
